body:
## Pull request overview

This PR improves API diagnosability and UI accuracy by introducing explicit handler-readiness signals in discovery, semantic dispatcher error envelopes, and route coverage/health reporting schemas—then using these signals in Studio to hide endpoints that will fail at runtime.

**Changes:**
- Added discovery & REST API schema fields for handler readiness/implementation status, plus new route health/coverage report schemas.
- Added dispatcher semantic error response schema and added `/api/v1/health` to the default dispatcher routes.
- Updated runtime dispatcher/plugin and Studio discovery hook to return/consume semantic 404s and filter endpoints by `handlerReady`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 11 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts | Adds `handlerStatus` to endpoint schema and introduces `RouteCoverageReportSchema` for adapter coverage reporting. |
| packages/spec/src/api/dispatcher.zod.ts | Adds `/health` to default routes and introduces dispatcher semantic error schemas. |
| packages/spec/src/api/dispatcher.test.ts | Adds tests for the new health route and dispatcher error schemas. |
| packages/spec/src/api/discovery.zod.ts | Adds `ServiceStatus` enum, optional `handlerReady`, and a `RouteHealthReportSchema`. |
| packages/spec/src/api/discovery.test.ts | Adds tests for `ServiceStatus`, `handlerReady`, and health report schemas. |
| packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts | Adds semantic route-not-found response and an internal `/health` handler; emits `handlerReady` for discovery. |
| packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts | Returns semantic 404 on unhandled results and registers `${prefix}/health`. |
| apps/studio/src/hooks/use-api-discovery.ts | Filters service endpoints by `handlerReady` with backward-compatible status fallback. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the new schemas and runtime/studio behavior changes. |
</details>

`handlerReady` is marked `.optional()`, and the tests confirm it parses to `undefined` when omitted, but the JSDoc/description says `@default false` and implies “omitted or false” are equivalent. This is misleading for clients that need to distinguish “unverified/unknown” (omitted) vs an explicit `false`.

Consider removing the `@default` tag and clarifying the semantics (e.g., omitted = unverified, `true` = verified present, `false` = verified missing/stub) to match the intended optional-field design.
```suggestion
   *
   * Semantics:
   * - `undefined` (omitted) = handler readiness is unknown / not yet verified.
   * - `true`                = handler is registered in the adapter / dispatcher (safe to call).
   * - `false`               = route is declared but no handler exists or only a stub is present
   *                            — requests are expected to receive 501 Not Implemented.
   *
   * Clients SHOULD check this flag before displaying or invoking a service endpoint and may
   * distinguish between "unknown" (omitted) and "known missing" (`false`).
   */
  handlerReady: z.boolean().optional().describe(
    'Whether the HTTP handler is confirmed to be mounted. '
    + 'Omitted = readiness unknown/unverified; true = handler mounted; false = handler missing or stub (likely 501).'
```

`RouteHealthEntrySchema.method` is currently `z.string()`, even though the repo already defines a shared `HttpMethod` enum schema (`packages/spec/src/shared/http.zod.ts`) and other API schemas use it. Using `HttpMethod` here would prevent invalid method strings and keep method validation consistent across protocols.

The 404 hint hardcodes `GET /api/v1/discovery`, but this plugin supports a configurable `prefix` (defaults to `/api/v1`). If a consumer sets a different prefix, the hint becomes wrong/misleading.

Consider passing the configured prefix into `sendResult()` (or generating the hint at the call site) so the suggested discovery URL matches the actual mounted routes.
```suggestion
            hint: 'No handler matched this request. Check the API discovery endpoint for available routes.',
```

The fallback comment says the status-based check is `status !== 'unavailable' && status !== 'stub' && status !== 'registered'`, but the actual implementation only allows `status === 'available' || status === 'degraded'` when `handlerReady` is missing. Please align the comment with the real predicate (or adjust the predicate if the comment reflects the intended behavior).
```suggestion
        // treat status === 'available' or status === 'degraded' as equivalent to handlerReady: true.
```

`DispatcherErrorCode` is defined as a string enum (`'404' | '405' | ...`), but `DispatcherErrorResponseSchema.error.code` is a numeric `z.number().int()`, and the tests validate numeric codes (404, 501, 503). This mismatch makes it easy for adapters/clients to pick the wrong type.

Consider making `DispatcherErrorCode` numeric literals (404/405/501/503) and reusing it in `error.code` (or dropping `DispatcherErrorCode` if `error.code` is intentionally free-form).
Minor doc issue: the comment says the dispatcher must distinguish between “these three failure modes”, but four modes are listed (404/405/501/503). Update the wording to avoid confusion.

`RouteCoverageEntrySchema.method` is `z.string()`, but `RestApiEndpointSchema.method` already uses the shared `HttpMethod` enum. Using `HttpMethod` here would keep validation consistent and prevent invalid method strings in coverage reports.
```suggestion
  method: HttpMethod.describe('HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)'),
```

`handlerStatus` enum values are duplicated in multiple places in this file (`RestApiEndpointSchema` and `RouteCoverageEntrySchema`). Consider extracting a shared `HandlerStatusSchema` constant and reusing it to avoid future drift if the allowed values change.

This entry says `handlerReady` has default `false`, but in the schema it’s defined as `.optional()` (and the tests assert it becomes `undefined` when omitted). The changelog should reflect the actual semantics (omitted = unverified/unknown) to avoid misleading downstream consumers.
```suggestion
  table but whose HTTP handler has not been verified. Added optional `handlerReady` boolean
  field (omitted = unverified/unknown) so clients can filter handler-ready services before
  displaying endpoints when the value is explicitly `true`.
```

Changelog claims `HttpDispatcher` added `notImplemented()` and `serviceUnavailable()` helpers, but `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` currently only contains the newly added `routeNotFound()` helper (no `notImplemented`/`serviceUnavailable` identifiers exist). Please either implement the helpers or update the changelog to match what was actually added.
```suggestion
  Added `routeNotFound()` (404) helper method.
```
